description: Record the person's own answer to proposed statements: affirm, correct (corrected_text), expand (addition), reject, remove, place (grouping, the person's own choice), or attach_evidence (a document passage). person_words, their reply as they said it, is required for every action but attach_evidence. A correction or expansion stays unaffirmed unless affirmed is true because the person affirmed the new wording in the same reply.

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

channel.description: How the person said it; text when omitted

person_words.description: The person's reply, as they said it

name: respond_to_my_statements

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Respond to My Statements
